{{Quote|We're on your tail, General Kenobi. |Davijaan, during the Battle of Coruscant|<ref name="ep3" />}}
'''Davijaan''', who flew under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] '''Odd Ball''', was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] and [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]], who served as leader of [[Clone Flight Squad Seven/Legends|Clone Flight Squad Seven]]. Odd Ball was commissioned in the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and participated in early campaigns such as [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Teth]]. He later was given the call sign of "'''Red Two'''" during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Thank you, sir. Sorry I panicked.''"<br />"''That's all right, Odd Ball. It happens to everybody.|Odd Ball and Kenobi, during the Battle of Teth|audio=OddBallPanicked-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
Davijaan was given the name "Odd Ball" by [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]] during his participation in the [[ARC program/Legends|ARC program]].<ref name="Obsession 4" />

[[File:Oddball_Teth.png|thumb|left|200px|Davijaan in Phase I armor at the Battle of Teth]]
In 22 BBY, he flew a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], where he was hit by a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid]] and fell into panic. But after [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] shot the enemy starfighter down, he regained control of himself and apologized to the general.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />

Later in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Odd Ball served under Obi-Wan Kenobi during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. When a battalion of the 501st led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Rex/Legends|Captain Rex]] were surrounded by [[Umbaran militia]] and forced to retreat off of the ridge, Odd Ball led a squadron of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-Wing]] bombers to destroy the ridge and the enemy Umbarans.<ref name="DoU">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>

[[File:JTKTM_Oddball.png|thumb|Davijaan pursues Ahsoka in his gunship.]][[20 BBY/Legends|One year later]], Odd Ball was located at a [[Republic military base]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] escaped from the base. Under orders from Anakin Skywalker, Odd Ball piloted a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] after the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]]. Odd Ball hovered his gunship over a flight of stairs that Tano was using to try to get away. The Jedi Padawan, however, jumped onto an industrial pipe and cut her way into it, thereby preventing Odd Ball and the other pilots from continuing the chase.<ref name="JWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>

During the final months of the Clone Wars, Odd Ball flew the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Intervention]]'' during the [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Battle of Boz Pity]] and, with help from Anakin Skywalker, broke through the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] blockade in orbit.<ref name="Obsession 4">[[Obsession 4|''Obsession'' 4]]</ref>

Odd Ball served as [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] Leader of Squad Seven in an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], where he and his pilots launched from [[Ro-ti-Mundi/Legends|''Ro-ti-Mundi'']]<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> to assist [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Obi-Wan Kenobi. Though many of his pilots were killed in deadly dogfights with [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture'' droid starfighters]] and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]], Odd Ball's mission was a success, allowing Kenobi time to reach [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] in time to rescue [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="ep3" />

Only days later, he would serve General Kenobi again in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] as part of the task force sent to the system. However, the result of the conflict was the presumed demise of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] whom he had fought alongside on numerous occasions.<ref name="ep3" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Oddball-TCW.png|thumb|right|150px|Davijaan, in Phase I armor]]
Odd Ball was portrayed by [[Temuera Morrison]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. He was voiced in the audio narration of both the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Revenge of the Sith'' novel]] and ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' by [[Jonathan Davis]]. He appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], played by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. Temuera Morrison voiced Odd Ball in a cutscene of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''.
